facts: Parties: Juniper Bioscience plc (Buyer), Lowther Technologies Ltd (Seller); the Company is Ashcombe Media Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 11 January 2027; Closing is scheduled for 19 March 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Eskdale Engineering Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $2,750,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Eskdale Robotics Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
